summary: System shows strong architectural patterns but contains critical security vulnerabilities in legacy VB6 code requiring immediate remediation before modernization.

hotspots.reason: SQL injection vulnerabilities in both balance check and deposit operations using string concatenation
No input validation or error handling for financial amounts in deposit operation
High import coupling in analyst agent (25 imports) may indicate architectural complexity

risks.title: SQL Injection in Banking Operations
risks.description: Legacy VB6 code constructs SQL queries through string concatenation, allowing potential account number and amount manipulation

risks.title: No Transaction Atomicity
risks.description: Deposit operation lacks transaction boundaries, risking data inconsistency in concurrent scenarios

risks.title: Missing Authentication Context
risks.description: No authentication or authorization mechanisms visible in legacy banking operations

risks.title: Unvalidated Financial Inputs
risks.description: Amount inputs not validated for type, range, or format before database operations
